thread:
alyssa: Heads-up — canary shows a throughput drop at seqlen=512. Kernel selector picked an fp8-optimized path on some hosts that don't actually have fp8 implemented -> big latency regression.
ben: can you paste the probe output and a short perf sample?
alyssa: sure, probe output from r3-gpu-20: 
```
{"device":0,"sm":86,"driver":537,"has_tensor_cores":true,"has_bf16":true,"has_fp8":true,"kernel_paths":[] }
```
perf: seqlen=512, batch=8 -> 1.1x median latency vs baseline.
kai: @alyssa that probe looks suspicious — SM=86 but driver 537 toggling has_fp8=true feels like a driver/agent mismatch. We added a soft-fallback in selector v2 but it only runs for seqlen<256. For seqlen>=512 we prefer fp8 path unconditionally. :thinking:
ben: how reproducible is this? single host or fleet wide?
alyssa: reproduced on 3/6 canary nodes, all r3-gpu-20. Hosts with older firmware show the misflag.
maria: looking at kernel mapping logic: we treat has_fp8 flag as authoritative. The mismatch happens when nvml reports capability but the micro-opset isn't present so kernel fails to achieve expected throughput (emulation or driver-side fallback).
kai: short-term mitigation: push a config override to force bf16 path for r3-gpu-20 via kernel_map_override. Example: `kernel_map_override: {"device_pattern":"r3-gpu-20","force_path":"bf16"}`. That should recover perf while we fix detection.
ben: long-term we should validate with a tiny microbenchmark during probe: dispatch a 64x64 fp8 gemm and measure cycles/throughput. If throughput < threshold, mark has_fp8=false. Also record both reported flags and microbench result in the trace.
alyssa: I'll draft the probe microbench and a canary job. Also adding trace tags: selected_kernel_id, reported_flags, microbench_fp8_result.
ben: add test matrix: seqlen [256,512,1024] x batch [1,8,32] to find the tipping point. Make the canary emit per-token latency and kernel id.
kai: I'll prep a quick selector patch that disables auto-fp8 for driver<538 or when firmware<2025-04-01. Won't land without tests but will be fast. :hammer:
maria: create a Jira and mark P0 until we verify canary recovery. Also run fleet query to list hosts with has_fp8=true but sm<90.
devops-bot: Incident created: INF-9876 - kernel selector fp8 misroute (priority=P0)
alyssa: thanks all. Uploading logs to s3://redwood-perf/canary/6312345678/ and will attach perf traces.
ben: nice. After patch we should also add a unit that asserts selector never chooses an fp8 kernel when microbench says no.
alyssa: agreed — I'll include that in the PR.
summary: short thread about fp8 capability flag mismatch causing kernel selector to pick wrong path and a perf regression
